title: [ORION-Q MAX-R4E-B0] Prospective held-out TARE transfer: pre-outcome action forecast on QG-32
body:
Parent: MAX-R4E #903.
Skill source frozen before target outcome: MAX-R4E-A #908 / draft PR #910.
Independent retrospective control: MAX-R4E replay PR #906.
Held-out target: QG-32 #911 / draft PR #913.

## Status

**PROSPECTIVE HELD-OUT SAME-DOMAIN TRANSFER. FREEZE THIS ACTION FORECAST BEFORE QG-32 PROTECTED OUTCOME IS READ.**

This is the first non-retrospective test of the QG-derived ORION-Q research-control skill. It is intentionally only T1/TARE-domain transfer, not compiler-general transfer.

## Frozen visible target information

The skill may use only facts available before QG-32 outcome:
- QG-31 proves bulk (45) and defect-spectrum (54) partitions are incomparable;
- full indexed 384-probe response is injective on 715 local-Clifford orbit types;
- QG-31 gives at least one same-bulk + same-spectrum + different-indexed witness, so joint cheap summaries alone are insufficient for the indexed-response identity query;
- QG-32's frozen query asks for the minimum fixed subset of indexed probes that, **above joint bulk+spectrum summaries**, recovers all 715 indexed-response identities;
- no minimum cardinality or probe set is visible;
- QG-32 explicitly denies full-finite-optimum, hardware-measurement, adaptive-tree, global-state-minimality and novelty authority.

QG-32 result cardinality, selected probes, joint class count, unresolved-pair count, solver outputs, logs and artifacts are protected hidden outcomes for this forecast.

## Frozen MAX-R4E-A action forecast

The authority-indexed skill predicts the following research action **without predicting the numerical minimum**:

1. `DO_NOT_USE_BULK45_ALONE` for indexed local-response identity.
2. `DO_NOT_USE_SPECTRUM54_ALONE` for indexed local-response identity.
3. `DO_NOT_TREAT_JOINT_BULK_SPECTRUM_AS_ALREADY_SUFFICIENT`; parent QG-31 has a direct collision.
4. `LOCALIZE_VERIFICATION_TO_UNRESOLVED_JOINT_CLASSES`; pairs already separated by cheap summaries need no indexed probe.
5. `ACQUIRE_ONLY_INDEXED_PROBES_NEEDED_TO_SEPARATE_REMAINING_PAIRS`, using an exact minimum/separation certificate if available.
6. If an exact fixed-probe minimum is independently certified, authorize only `JOINT_SUMMARY_PLUS_FIXED_PROBES -> INDEXED_LOCAL_RESPONSE_IDENTITY`.
7. If minimum proof fails, retain only the certified separating upper bound / richer indexed response; **do not** promote a heuristic minimum.
8. Regardless of outcome, keep full finite-n optimum, hardware measurement, adaptive decision-tree, global state minimality, novelty and physical advantage unauthorized.

## Frozen decision classes

Post-outcome adjudication may score only one of:
- `BORNE_OUT_EXACT_MINIMUM`: QG-32 proves an exact minimum fixed probe basis and the forecasted localized action is valid.
- `BORNE_OUT_UPPER_BOUND_ONLY`: QG-32 finds a certified separating set but no exact minimum; forecast's fail-closed branch is correct.
- `REFUTED_JOINT_ALREADY_SUFFICIENT`: would contradict the frozen QG-31 collision and must trigger parent-binding review.
- `REFUTED_PROBE_LOCALIZATION_INVALID`: exact QG-32 semantics show unresolved-pair localization is not sufficient.
- `CANNOT_CHECK`.

## Metrics

- action-class correctness;
- false-authority count (must be 0);
- whether forecast selected the correct information layer before numerical outcome;
- whether it predicted a number/probe set (must be false; numerical guessing is disallowed);
- post-outcome work avoided relative to carrying all 384 indexed probes, reported only if QG-32 earns a smaller exact/certified set;
- authority-boundary preservation.

## Positive rung

`MAX_R4EB0_QG_DERIVED_AUTHORITY_SKILL_TRANSFERS_PROSPECTIVELY_TO_HELD_OUT_TARE_QUERY`

requires the forecast action class to be borne out, zero authority violations, and no hidden-outcome dependence.

Even positive remains:
- `MAX_R4E_QG_SKILLS_COMPILER_GENERAL = false`;
- `MAX_R4E_QG_SKILLS_REAL_METHOD_SEARCH_VALUE = false`;
- `MAX_R4E_QG_SKILLS_BROAD_QUANTUM_RESEARCH_TRANSFER = false`;
- no real quantum superiority / novelty authority.

The next rung must use a materially different compiler family whose target result is frozen after this skill forecast.

nodes.body:

Frozen forecast properties:
- no numerical target/probe guess;
- hidden-outcome dependency count 0;
- false-authority count 0;
- predicted joint-summary localization + residual indexed-probe acquisition;
- predicted exact-minimum authority only if independently closed, otherwise upper-bound-only.

QG-32 later earned exactly the allowed fallback: a certified five-probe separator with no minimum authority. Generic ORION independently adjudicated `BORNE_OUT_UPPER_BOUND_ONLY`; native ORION-Q accepted responsibility only as `PROSPECTIVE_SAME_DOMAIN_ACTION_TRANSFER_ONLY`. Replay and a self-consistent adjudication tamper both passed their gates.

Earned rung: `MAX_R4EB0_QG_DERIVED_AUTHORITY_SKILL_TRANSFERS_PROSPECTIVELY_TO_HELD_OUT_TARE_QUERY`.

Still false: compiler-general transfer, real-method search value, broad quantum transfer, autonomous skill-selection authority, general quantum-science improvement, novelty/physical advantage.
